name: agent-standards
description: Skills, subagents and MCP servers from agent-standards, split by domain so a project installs only what it uses.

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: Skills that subagents in two or more domains preload, such as coding standards, security review, TDD, logging and git practice. Every domain plugin depends on it.

plugins.name: python
plugins.description: Python and machine learning, with the python-pro and ml-engineer subagents and the PyTorch skill.

plugins.name: jvm
plugins.description: Java and Spring Boot, with the java-pro subagent and the Java, Spring Boot and SOAP skills.

plugins.name: go
plugins.description: Go services, with the go-pro subagent and the Go patterns skill.

plugins.name: backend
plugins.description: Backend services and HTTP APIs, with the backend-architect, api-documenter and api-tester subagents and the API design, backend, Node.js and Keycloak skills.

plugins.name: data
plugins.description: Databases, with the database-expert subagent and the PostgreSQL, migration and MongoDB skills.

plugins.name: web-frontend
plugins.description: Web interfaces, with the Angular, React and Next.js, accessibility, design system and UI subagents and their skills.

plugins.name: mobile
plugins.description: Flutter and Dart apps, with the flutter-expert subagent and the Dart and Flutter skill.

plugins.name: devops
plugins.description: Delivery and operations, with the devops, incident, observability and release subagents and the deployment, Docker and Ansible skills.

plugins.name: review-and-security
plugins.description: Code review, security audit, codebase mapping and legacy migration, with four subagents and the review and duplication skills.

plugins.name: testing
plugins.description: Tests, debugging and performance measurement, with four subagents and the regression, end-to-end runbook and Playwright skills.

plugins.name: docs-and-product
plugins.description: Documentation, legal drafts, SEO and project tracking, with four subagents and the SEO, tracking and Jira skills.

plugins.name: embedded
plugins.description: Embedded C and hardware, with the embedded-c-engineer subagent and the Arduino, KiCad and 3D printing skills.

plugins.name: game
plugins.description: Unity games, with the unity-game-dev subagent and the Unity skill.

plugins.name: agent-tooling
plugins.description: Agent configuration and research, with the agent-engineer subagent and the agentic engineering, research and automation inventory skills.

plugins.name: linux
plugins.description: Linux desktop administration on Arch, CachyOS and KDE Plasma. Off until you enable it.

plugins.name: windows-and-mac
plugins.description: Windows and macOS administration and PowerShell scripting. Off until you enable it.

plugins.name: homelab
plugins.description: Homelab hosts and services, with the home-assistant-engineer subagent and the Proxmox, router, Syncthing and machine health skills. Off until you enable it.

plugins.name: personal-tools
plugins.description: Obsidian, JetBrains IDE configuration and the self-hosted AscendMemory, ascend-web-hunter and AudioScribe services. Off until you enable it.

plugins.name: mcp-context7
plugins.description: The Context7 documentation MCP server.

plugins.name: mcp-mongodb
plugins.description: The MongoDB MCP server, read-only, started with npx.

plugins.name: mcp-grafana
plugins.description: The Grafana MCP server, started with uvx.

plugins.name: mcp-playwright
plugins.description: The Playwright browser MCP server, started with npx. It can write local files.

plugins.name: mcp-chrome-devtools
plugins.description: The Chrome DevTools MCP server, started with npx. It can write local files.

plugins.name: mcp-redis
plugins.description: The Redis MCP server, started with uvx.

plugins.name: mcp-sonarqube
plugins.description: The SonarQube MCP server, started with docker run, which pulls the image on every start.

plugins.name: mcp-n8n
plugins.description: The n8n MCP server, started with npx.

plugins.name: mcp-home-assistant
plugins.description: The Home Assistant MCP server, started with uvx and reading its settings from an env file in your home directory.

plugins.name: mcp-all
plugins.description: Every MCP server plugin in one install.

plugins.name: all
plugins.description: Core and every development domain in one install. Host groups and MCP servers stay separate installs.
